_comment: Retrieval test set. Each question names the document it is about and `gold`: any chunk containing one of these substrings counts as a hit. The eval script checks every gold string occurs in at least one chunk.

questions.q: What time does the clinic open on Sunday?
Which doctor sees children and on which days?
How much does a dentist consultation cost?
Can I cancel an appointment without paying anything?
Where is the nearest hospital with a 24-hour emergency room?
Can the receptionist suggest a medicine for my fever?
रविवार को क्लिनिक कितने बजे खुलता है?
बच्चों के डॉक्टर किन दिनों में बैठते हैं?
त्वचा के डॉक्टर की फीस कितनी है?
सीने में तेज़ दर्द हो तो क्या करना चाहिए?
ख़ून की जाँच की रिपोर्ट कब तक मिल जाती है?
gold: Reports are ready the same day

questions.q: अपॉइंटमेंट कैंसिल करने के लिए कितने घंटे पहले बताना होगा?
gold: at least 3 hours before the appointment

questions.q: Sunday ko clinic kab khulta hai?
Appointment cancel karna ho to kitne ghante pehle batana padta hai?
gold: at least 3 hours before the appointment

questions.q: Payment UPI se ho sakta hai kya?
gold: Payment is accepted by cash, UPI

questions.q: Pharmacy kitne baje tak khuli rehti hai?
gold: The pharmacy inside the clinic is open
